_comment: This configuration file controls all adjustable settings for the incubator system.

GPIO._comment: Define GPIO pins for various hardware components.

MQTT._comment: MQTT settings for remote monitoring and control.

EGG_TURNER._comment: Controls egg rotation, including target angles and movement duration.

ADAPTIVE_CLIMATE_CONTROL._comment: Automatically adjust heating and humidity based on sensor data.

LOGGING._comment: Toggle logging features for debugging and system monitoring.

POWER_EFFICIENCY_MODE._comment: If enabled, reduces power consumption by limiting sensor polling frequency.
